# Control and component

The base classes every control and nonvisual component derives from, with layout, docking, anchoring and validation vocabularies.

(api-gui-forms-component)=
## Component

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/component/component/component.hpp>
class Component
```

Component owns the alive-to-disposing-to-disposed transition and revokes acquired work in strict reverse order before subclass teardown.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Component() = default` | Constructs an alive component; copying is prohibited. |
| `virtual ~Component()` | Provides polymorphic destruction without implicitly re-entering virtual teardown. |
| `void dispose()` | Verifies thread policy, enters disposing once, revokes owned work, runs subclass teardown, and commits disposed. |
| `ComponentState component_state() const noexcept` | Returns the exact lifecycle state. |
| `bool is_alive() const noexcept` | Reports whether mutation remains admissible. |
| `bool is_disposed() const noexcept` | Reports completed teardown. |
| `void own_revocable(const std::weak_ptr<detail::Revocable>& revocable)` | Adds weak revocation authority while alive or immediately disconnects work acquired after teardown begins. |
| `void own_subscription(SubscriptionToken subscription)` | Transfers the token into this component. Disposal/destruction disconnects it; no ownership of the event publisher or callback target is introduced. A dead component disconnects immediately. Failure also disconnects the transferred token. Like event dispatch, this is execution-thread confined. |
| `std::size_t owned_subscription_count() const noexcept` |  |

**Protected members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `virtual void verify_dispose_thread()` | Allows an owner to enforce disposal affinity before state changes. |
| `virtual void on_dispose() noexcept` | Provides noexcept subclass teardown after revocation. |
| `void revoke_owned_work() noexcept` | Exchanges and disconnects the revocation stack in reverse acquisition order. |

**Data members and type aliases**

```cpp
using Ptr = std::shared_ptr<Component>;
```

(api-gui-forms-componentcontainer)=
## ComponentContainer

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/component/component_container/component_container.hpp>
class ComponentContainer final
```

ComponentContainer owns a unique ordered set of shared components and disposes the captured ownership sequence exactly once.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ComponentContainer() = default` | Constructs an empty live container; copying is prohibited. |
| `~ComponentContainer()` | Disposes remaining ownership. |
| `void add(Component::Ptr component)` | Rejects null or post-disposal ownership and ignores an already-owned identity. |
| `Component::Ptr remove(const Component& component)` | Transfers one matching shared owner without disposal. |
| `std::span<const Component::Ptr> components() const noexcept` | Returns the current ordered ownership view. |
| `bool contains(const Component& component) const noexcept` | Tests pointer identity. |
| `void dispose()` | Atomically retires the container and disposes the captured sequence in ownership order. |
| `bool is_disposed() const noexcept` | Reports whether ownership has retired. |

(api-gui-forms-control)=
## Control

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/control/control/control.hpp>
class Control : public Component, public std::enable_shared_from_this<Control>
```

Control is the retained visual root and invariant owner for stable/runtime identity, hierarchy, geometry, layout transactions, initialization batching, style/theme resolution, typed invalidation, input eligibility and routing hooks, validation, binding, semantic projection, dispatch, focus, lifetime, and provider extensions.

- Every control has a nonempty immutable `StableId` and a process-local `RuntimeId`; the mutable `name` is distinct from both and publishes a tokenized change event.
- Requested bounds reject nonfinite or negative extents and honor retained minimum/maximum size. Reading arranged or absolute geometry may execute the declared layout read barrier; it is not a raw field read.
- `invalidate(Dirty)` marks the affected control or path, `invalidate_subtree` marks every descendant, and `invalidate_declared` rejects undeclared effects in development builds. The dirty vocabulary distinguishes measure, arrange, paint, hit test, text, style, resource, semantics, and accessibility.
- `begin_init()` and `end_init()` nest. Stock property events remain synchronous outside initialization and coalesce by event identity inside it; the final payloads publish in first-event order after the outer commit, and `initialization_completed` reports the combined dirty flags.
- Subclass hooks `measure`, `arrange`, `on_paint`, `visual_outsets`, `hit_test_local`, the pointer/key/text/drag route hooks, focus notification, and `on_activate` define a custom control. Drawing uses the renderer-neutral `Painter` vocabulary.
- Portable coordinate conversion terminates at Window client coordinates; a native desktop-screen origin remains host-contract work.

```cpp
std::string type;
std::string stable_id;
Rect requested_bounds{};
std::vector<StaticNode> children;
```

## AnchorStyles

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/control/control/control.hpp>
enum class AnchorStyles
```

Values: `none`, `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`.
